diagnostics.message: aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification declares three lambda_function blocks — module.cur_per_service, module.cur_per_resource and module.cur_per_resource_process — but its depends_on only lists aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service and aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource. The PutBucketNotificationConfiguration call validates that every destination Lambda grants s3.amazonaws.com invoke permission, so the third block (prefix "tmp/cur-per-resource/") must also be applied after aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process; otherwise the very first apply fails with "Unable to validate the following destination configurations". Add it to depends_on (there is no attribute on the notification that can reference the permission, so a bare depends_on is the correct fix).

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource creates a BCM Data Exports export that delivers into aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, which is only writable by bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com because of aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy (the "EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy" statement). The export depends on the bucket but has no ordering against the bucket policy, and AWS validates the destination bucket's policy when the export is created, so a fresh apply can fail while the policy has not yet been attached. Order the export after aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy.
